PR #2796 (TASK-1981) at 2ddaeaafef: the review confirms the detached-HEAD fix and the retitle. ONE item is left, from my addendum mail (it was missed):

aida-cli-lib/src/upgrade_release.rs, task_1981_release_status_tests::task_1981_release_status_failure_prevents_publication, is unchanged since cbb9f66bec. It sets up no origin remote and asserts only !store/.git/refs/heads/main.exists(). That always holds in a repo with no commits, and with no remote a push would fail anyway, so the test proves nothing.

Fix: give the store a real bare-repo origin seeded with a known ref. Make the release-status step fail, then assert (a) the command fails, (b) the bare origin's refs are byte-identical to before (same ref list and same SHAs), and (c) no new local commit was published. Optionally add a positive control: the same setup with status succeeding DOES advance origin.

New commit, no force-push. Gates: make check-ci-fast plus make test-touched. Push, then mail the advisor the SHA. This should be the last round.
subject: #2796 round 2: one test left (prove no push)
